_note: Key Terms head -> target, for heads whose wording does not match a definitions entry name or a lesson section title. A value starting with / is a lesson URL; anything else is a definitions entry id. A key of the form '<registry key>:<term>' overrides the plain term for that one tool. Terms deliberately absent stay bold: they are page-local scaffolding (geometric proof, bisector, positive root) or have no trigonometry lesson (pythagorean triple).
